model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази диаграма представлява два линейни диаграма, всеки от които показва разпределение на категориите в две отделни групи. Всеки от диаграмите включва общо четири сектори, които са оцветени в оранжев, зелен, сив и бор. В диаграма (а) оранжевят сектор представлява 9%, зеленът - 31%, зеленят - 21% и синият - 5%. В диаграма (b) оранжевият сектор представлява 27%, синият - 19%, зеленият - 17% и кафявият - 38%. Включени са етикети с проценти в отделните сектори и легенда, която асоциира цветовете с конкретните категории. Няма видима визуализация, която да подчертава някой от секторите.
model_annotations.English: This chart presents a comparison of proportions related to chemical equilibrium constants for two different systems, as indicated by the labels “this” and “the.” The chart consists of two pie charts, (a) and (b), each containing six slices representing different categories. In pie chart (a), there is a yellow slice representing approximately 7%, a red slice representing 9%, a green slice representing 17%, a blue slice representing 21%, an orange slice representing 31%, and a purple slice representing 5%. A legend is present, indicating that the yellow is “chemical to III”, the red is “the chemical,” the green is “the equilibrium constant,” the blue is “the,” the orange is “the,” and the purple is “III.” Pie chart (b) displays a yellow slice representing approximately 27%, a red slice representing 19%, a green slice representing 15%, a blue slice representing 38%, and an orange slice representing 2%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, indicating the numerical value for each proportion.  The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in both charts.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von chemischen Spezies in zwei verschiedenen Systemen, (a) und (b). Diagramm (a) besteht aus fünf Segmenten, die in den Farben Gelb, Grün, Blau und Braun dargestellt sind, die jeweils einen Anteil von 9 %, 17 %, 21 % und 38 % ausmachen. Diagramm (b) enthält ebenfalls fünf Segmente, unterteilt in die Farben Gelb, Braun, Grün, Blau und Beige und repräsentiert Anteile von 19 %, 27 %, 31 %, 5 % und 15 % bzw. Alle Segmente beinhalten die angegebenen Prozentangaben innerhalb der jeweiligen Segmentgrenzen, und beide Diagramme verfügen über eine Legende, die die Farben den jeweiligen Kategorien zuordnet.
